questions.stem: A 32-Year-old woman is 34 weeks pregnant and comes to the emergency department because she cannot walk, secondary to swelling in her legs. Physical examination shows a temperature of 36.5° C (97.7° F), a pulse of 95/min, and a blood pressure of 150/90 mm Hg. The patient complains of a severe headache but has no other symptoms. Which of the following tests would help most in the initial diagnosis of this patient?
